Min-Ho Gija, a great engineer who serves as the master craftsman chief the naval engineering of Hyunseo directly under the government, the user of the Musi-Chuga, a well renowned engineer of Hyunseo in the ports of Seonhang, a large man with black hair and average white skin wearing the typical white shirt of a shipping worker, but with a red coat differing him from other workers , 66 years old, and over half a century of experience in naval working.
[i]Move these plates of metal my boyz! [/i]
He first ordered pointing his now metallic hand to a medium sized metallic piece in front of him, and moving it toward a large cruise ship, then pointed at his other workers, 2 boys, not even reaching their 20s, wearing simple blue coats, Nae Park Woo and Jae Sun, boys with respectively dark brown and black hairs, they seemed excited to do the work , they moved and then with the torches they prepared to weld the plate in place.
"Bah, you should try a little bit more effort into this boyz!"
The engineer smiled to them with a authoritarian tone,but far from being "oppressive", he took off one of their torches and started guiding it way precisely to weld the metal piece into the ship.
"There you go!"
The two turned to Min-Ho, the brown-haired one's eyes lit up and he immediately thanked him:
"Thank you, Master Gija!"
The engineer felt flattered, approached the boy, and placed his hand on his shoulder.
"Don't call me 'master,' kiddo, we've known each other for about 10 years! And you too, Rin Jae Sun, don't try to act all introverted, I know you're just pretending! It could have worked a decade ago but not anymore!"
The other boy looked a little awkward, hiding an almost smile, while the engineer took out his coat two tangerines and thrown at the boys, who grabbed and started peeling it off.
"now go off and eat, i will take some affairs with their captain..."
The boys nodded into understanding, and soon left the place, Min-Ho looked at his side, to the man at his side, a man from Daesun, the captain of the cruise, captain Yo Min Gyu.
"and you young man, how the sea treats life from where you come? Is it nice traveling around Hyunseo?"
He tried to pull off a taking with the captain, who happily answered, keeping friendly tone.
"Me?  Oh yes, Hyunseo has became quite a destination for our daesunite people to visit due recent treatises..."
Min-Ho looked at the foreign with a warming glance, and then sit down a bench, quite rustic, but would serve.
"Ah, indeed, our engineering companies had been receiving a influx of more of your ships here, but our love for job is more than even 1000 ships at port to be repaired!"
He looked up to the blue skies where birds were flying between clouds.
"A ship is a work of art, for me, every single ship,no matter it use, even the warships are a thing to be proud..."
The daesunite captain looked as the man was thinking,more like talking to himself at this point, but still smiled anyways.
"such Philosophy!"

[i]Valddera's critical remarks shocked Daesun, a international pariah that had catered to genocidal communists could had no right to label Daesun as a traitor. An official response would be made to the Valdderan public about Valddera's imperialist sights on East Shamat. Daesun would also dispatch a warning to Hydronia and other nations deployed in Valddera demanding an immediate withdrawal, warning them about Daesun's future Bombardment of the Valdderan mainland. 

In the skies, the aerial battle was a complete overkill. The Daesunite air force received complete control of the Valdderan skies within 24 hours, but even with this assuring factor, the clouds were still dangerous. Valdderan air defenses that survived the initial bombing campaign leered in full force, proving to be a problem with actually carrying out any ground assaults. To combat this, Daesun focused on conducting precise ground strikes on remaining SAMs and air defences. A layered offensive strategy was instated, once a active SAM was detected by a AWAC or reconaissance drone, the coordinates and wavelength band of the system was uplinked to a local EA-18G, which focused on jamming and disrupting these systems before they could direct an attack. While the distraction ensued, F-15's were dispatched to the flash zone to operate a direct delivery drop off of JDAMs onto the targets. These were intended to strike with surgical precision, and leave Valdderan air defences constantly on the run.

In the vast expanses of the Northern sea, Valddera owned two major islands that proved strategically priceless if Daesun wanted to proliferate its influence in the artic. And so they were also listed onto the chopping block, Daesun dispatched its North Sea Strike Force 1, also known as NSTF-1 to the islands, accompanied by marines who travelled on LCU's and other watercraft. NSTF-1 consisted of 1 Virginia-class submarine, 3 Independence-class LCS, 2 Arleigh Burke-class destroyers, and 1 Antonio-class LPD, which acted as the command ship of the task force. Daesun had only one strategy in mind, striking as quickly as possible before local Valdderan military could reciprocate. Leading the pack of the task force was the single Virginia class submarine, staying submerged under the vast abyss, it stayed over 14 hours  ahead of its comrades. She was tasked with carrying out a lightning strike to disorient local Valdderan forces, while also making way for her partners. Analyzing the islands, the Virginia-class would search for Valdderan coastal artillery, SAM positions, minefields, communication nodes, and enemy radar signatures. Collected intel was put up on a broad information sharing band, allowing for the rest of the task force to listen in on what the Virginia class had found out. But information wasn't the only thing she seeked, her first objective still wasn't completed. Once the her armaments were within range of the Valdderan islands, the attack submarine would launch a fury of Tomohawk missiles, each streaking towards sophisticated high value targets such as coastal radars, C2 bunkers, and long range SAM sites. In total, a volley of 8 tomahawks screamed towards Valddera, each getting closer and closer as seconds passed by, the Valdderans only had so much time to effectively respond. Immediately after her assault, the Virginia class would resubmerge into low depth to wait for the rest of NSTF-1 to catch up, re-initiating its stealth to avoid detecting. Her attack was only the beginning, and paled in comparison to what awaited Valddera. 

But there was also another target that caught Daesun's eye, a pair of islands in the middle of the Shamite sea, two that were crucial in proliferating Daesun's influence in the sea. Just south of the islands roared the Mugunghwa shield, a heavy naval task force that had just completed its service in Astanir, contributing to Nordiheim's defeat in the Argossia. Their attention now veered north, towards Valddera's claims. But there was one major problem, the shield had to carefully thread itself through THEP territory, as a major alliance competing with Daesun for influence in the Shamite sea, caution was a priority. Mugunghwa's route traversed through [nation]Blobon[/nation]ite and [nation]BR Bob[/nation]ian waters, carefully avoiding any confrontation with THEP. A warning was also dispatched to [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]ns residing within the archipelago near Valddera's claims of the shield's action in Valddera. 

Once within operating range of Valddera's claims, the shield began a multi-layered analyzation campaign of the island's geography, topography, military, and communication assets. Recon drones such as the RQ-4 and Orlan-10 drones were dispatched to the island to analyze data and then send it back to Mugunghwa for dissection. The operation had to be precise, as Daesun could not afford losing a global hawk to Valdderan air defences. While the Orlan-10s were inexpensive and numerous, allowing for Daesun to dispatch many. 

Back in the mainland, the long idle of the 103rd infantry regiment finally ceased. Once Daesun  achieved full aerial superiority and began an operation eliminating remaining air defences, the airborne assault force could now operate on reduced caution. To avoid direct confrontation with the Valdderan army, the regiment focused on achieving a massive airlift straight to the capital, where they could then seize control of the country and de-esculate the situation. A mix of heavy CH-47's and A-64's were manned to lead the assault, with the Apaches acting as a spearhead, focusing on direct attacks on potential ground threats. While the Chinooks were the soft underbelly, containing most of the regiment, they were the heavy transport of the regiment and therefore needed sufficient defence to ensure safety. 

With contest in Valdderan airspace completely obliterated, heavy bombing campaigns could also be placed into action. B-52s deployed from Persephone were dispatched to operational bombing campaigns deep within Valdderan territory. Still paranoid about Valddera's SAM capabilities, the bombers focused on standoff range bombing. The bombers would focus on striking heavy Valdderan military nodes like command centers and bunkers with their AGM-158 JASSM-ER stand off missiles.[/i]

[b]Diplomatic Communication | Erene 2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

From: Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter

To my colleague and equivalent in the Massanikan League,

I hope this message finds you well. On behalf of the Government of the Second Flouesch Republic, and the Vëlvetel Local Council, I would like to inform your government of our formal request to participate in the 2027 Erene Olympic Games. The Republic, which at its heart is dedicated to the idea of cooperation among the nations, believes that sports will foster that exact same type of cooperation. We will begin assembling an official Olympic team effective immediately for our participation in the events. 

Additionally, the Vëlvetel Local Council, the legislative body that governs the day-to-day operations of our nation's captial, would like to inquire about the possibility of hosting the events in the city. The city already has a new stadium complex named the "Volkshalle," which would be capable of holding around 50,000 people and has a square footage of around 2,800,000. Additionally, the city has ample public transport capable of shuttling around tourists and two fully operational international airports; it is the opinion of the Local Council, therefore, that it would be a perfect spot for the games and bring in revenue into the city that will fuel further reconstruction and public housing efforts.

Once again, on behalf of the Government of the Second Flouesch Republic, have a blessed day.

Most sincerely, Secretariat of Forigen Affairs, Dr. Christian Welter
